---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  drop_na(Activity) |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "total_incidents") |>
  filter(total_incidents >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(fct_infreq(Activity)), fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs. Non-Fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    subtitle = "Activities with at least 50 reported incidents",
    x = "Number of Attacks",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
